CORE MATHEMATICS — TERMLY EXAM #4
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 400
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 4

2. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 22
   B. 11
   C. 122
   D. 121

3. Solve for x: x + 3 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 8
   C. 5
   D. 3

4. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 400

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 90
   C. 36
   D. 81

6. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 10
   C. 25
   D. 26

7. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 7
   C. 5
   D. 1

8. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 1
   C. 13
   D. 7

9. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 49
   C. 7
   D. 50

10. What is 4 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 20
   B. 9
   C. 21
   D. 1

11. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 4
   C. 32
   D. 12

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 10 000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

13. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 82
   B. 9
   C. 81
   D. 18

14. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 12
   B. 36
   C. 42
   D. 24

15. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 144
   C. 156
   D. 48

16. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 170
   C. 26
   D. 169

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

18. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

19. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

20. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

21. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

22. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
